title.en: Los Angeles opening radar starts with source-linked restaurant and retail summaries
title.zh: 洛杉磯新店雷達先從附來源連結的餐飲與零售摘要開始

excerpt.en: ChineseLosAngeles is tracking LA opening signals as short bilingual summaries with links back to local publishers, not copied restaurant or retail articles.
excerpt.zh: ChineseLosAngeles 會把洛杉磯新店訊號整理成簡短雙語摘要並附回本地媒體來源，而不是複製餐飲或零售報導。

body.en: The Los Angeles opening lane is scoped to local restaurants, retail storefronts, plaza activity, and neighborhood business changes across LA and the San Gabriel Valley. The feed starts from Los Angeles-specific publishers and keeps each item as an original summary with a clear source link.
body.zh: 洛杉磯新店 lane 聚焦洛杉磯與聖蓋博谷的餐廳、零售店面、商場動態與街區商業變化。內容會從洛杉磯專屬本地來源開始，每篇只保留原創摘要與清楚的來源連結。

body.en: This page does not republish third-party restaurant articles, captions, photos, or full descriptions. Readers who need the original reporting, address details, or publisher context should open the linked sources from the source panel.
body.zh: 此頁不轉載第三方餐飲文章、caption、照片或完整描述。需要原始報導、地址細節或媒體脈絡的讀者，可以從來源區塊打開原始連結。

title.en: SGV housing and transit watch uses LA-only source links
title.zh: 聖蓋博谷住房與交通觀察使用洛杉磯專屬來源連結

excerpt.en: The Los Angeles pipeline separates housing, development, transit, and street-policy signals from other city data so LA pages only serve LA-area articles.
excerpt.zh: 洛杉磯 pipeline 會把住房、開發、公共交通與街道政策訊號和其他城市資料分開，讓洛杉磯頁面只提供洛杉磯地區文章。

body.en: For Los Angeles readers, housing and transit questions often overlap. A development story can matter because of school pickup, Metro access, freeway time, parking, and whether a San Gabriel Valley family can keep its weekly routine realistic.
body.zh: 對洛杉磯讀者來說，住房與交通問題常常重疊。開發新聞之所以重要，可能是因為接送小孩、Metro 可達性、 freeway 時間、停車，以及聖蓋博谷家庭能不能維持實際可行的一週節奏。

body.en: ChineseLosAngeles keeps this lane in its own runtime store and links back to LA planning, development, and transportation sources. The goal is a source-linked local brief, not a copied article archive.
body.zh: ChineseLosAngeles 會把這個 lane 放在自己的 runtime store，並連回洛杉磯規劃、開發與交通來源。目標是附來源連結的本地摘要，而不是複製文章檔案。
